About me

I’m drawn to ideas that sit outside the usual playbook: things that haven’t been tried yet, or opportunities others might overlook. I enjoy exploring how AI and automation can solve problems in ways that save time and money. Before starting a project, I like to research the options and find the best balance between capability and cost. My curiosity extends beyond technology to games, films, shows, and books, anywhere a new idea or perspective can spark something worth building.

Case studies

Pilgrim Companion

AI guidance for Hajj and Umrah. A local-first question-answering application that retrieves multilingual sources and grounds responses in cited context.

Retrieval pipeline

A simplified view of the pipeline described in the project README.

  1. English or Arabic question
  2. Domain routing
  3. Dense and BM25 retrieval
  4. Rank fusion and relevance checks
  5. Optional reranking
  6. Grounded prompt and local or API model
  7. Streamed response with sources

Retrieval evaluation

Results reported in the repository for a 12-question English and Arabic regression set on a CPU development machine. These results are not a measure of religious correctness or production accuracy.

MetricResult
Retrieval Recall@4100%
Mean Reciprocal Rank0.926
Out-of-domain rejection100%
Median retrieval latency51.8 ms
Knowledge-base chunks123 unique chunks
  • Combines semantic and keyword retrieval for English and Arabic questions.
  • Supports local Ollama models and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
  • Includes source citations, streaming responses, and out-of-domain handling.
  • Uses conversation-safe caching for standalone questions to avoid reusing cached results for follow-up questions.
  • Python
  • FastAPI
  • RAG

Groundtruth

A retrieval evaluation toolkit for legal research. An evaluation harness for comparing retrieval approaches and detecting regressions in a legal research dataset.

Retrieval benchmark

Results reported in the project README for its 100-query evaluation set. Benchmark results are not evidence of legal safety or production readiness.

HomeLab TUI

A terminal dashboard for a self-hosted server. An SSH-friendly Linux terminal interface for monitoring host telemetry, Docker containers, and maintenance tasks.

Dashboard overview

Features described in the repository README. Availability depends on host configuration and permissions.

AreaWhat it shows or does
OverviewCPU, memory, network, disk usage, and container status
ContainersDocker container states and selected container actions
UpdatesCompose checks and eligible update options
Storage, network, securityHost diagnostics and checks
Backups, logs, maintenanceExplicitly invoked tasks, logging, and reporting
SettingsAnimation, polling, update pacing, and help
  • Brings host metrics, container status, logs, and maintenance tools into one interface.
  • Includes a demo mode with fictional data and disabled actions.
  • Supports configurable settings, keyboard navigation, and optional animation.
  • Go
  • Docker
  • Linux
